name: End-to-end testing (Playwright)
description: For testers verifying an application from the outside with Playwright. Gives test suites (one per spec file) and test scenarios derived from use cases, with given/when/then and their current status.
author: B2IT

personas.name: Testing
personas.description: The tester, verifying the target application from the outside with Playwright end-to-end tests derived from the use cases. A scenario names the use case it proves, the spec that proves it, and its current status.

node_types.name: Test suite
node_types.description: One Playwright spec file in the test project (specs drive the application through page objects). Its test scenarios sit in it.

node_types.name: Test scenario
node_types.description: One end-to-end test of the target application, written from a use case: what it sets up, what the user does, what must be true afterwards, and whether it passes.

fields.name: use_case
fields.label: Use case
fields.hint: The use case it proves, by its exact title.

fields.name: spec
fields.label: Spec
fields.hint: The spec file and test title: `tests/sign-in.spec.ts` › `signs in with valid credentials`.

fields.name: given
fields.label: Given
fields.hint: The state before the test: data, user, page.

fields.name: when
fields.label: When
fields.hint: What the user does, step by step.

fields.name: then
fields.label: Then
fields.hint: What must be true afterwards, as the user sees it.

fields.name: data
fields.label: Test data
fields.hint: The data the test relies on and how it gets there.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.hint: passing, failing or skipped — with the reason when it is not passing.
